usedFor: Shopify records the sale and Drift keeps the conversations, so “Order Paid” can feed “Update Known Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Update Known Contact” in Drift
bestTemplate.why: A paid order updates the contact Drift already knows, so chats reflect the purchase.

watchOut: “Update Known Contact” changes an existing contact only, so use “Create or Update Contact From External” for new buyers.
